picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI system solving a major open math problem would signal research-level capability with large implications for productivity and science.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI shapes where investment, talent and market value concentrate in a technology driving much of capital spending.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1.2T?
picks.why: An OpenAI listing above $1.2 trillion would test how public markets value AI and could reshape index concentration.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: With inflation already above 3.5%, a jump past 4.5% would pressure the Fed and real wages alike.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: A rise in U.S. unemployment above 4.2% would signal a cooling labor market and shift the outlook for rate policy.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.5% in Q4 2026?
picks.why: Solid fourth-quarter U.S. growth above 1.5% would indicate the economy is absorbing elevated inflation without stalling.
